Claim Diff

Cat 1 Diff

Type Safety

proven

Before

Strict mode: Enabled; strict-mode error count not applicable. Baseline counted syntax: 1340 total counted syntax nodes; 923 production counted syntax nodes. Dense files: api/src/routes/weeks.ts (85), projects.ts (51), issues.ts (49), UnifiedDocumentPage.tsx (37), api/src/db/seed.ts (35).

After

Latest counted syntax: 625 total counted syntax nodes; 409 production counted syntax nodes. Primary reduction: 1340 -> 625, -715 / -53.4%. Implicit any: 0 tsc implicit-any diagnostics; 47 production unannotated params still infer to any and are documented as follow-up. Tests: API 509 passing tests; web 168 passing tests; pnpm type-check passed.

Reviewer Meaning

Total counted type-safety syntax decreased from 1340 to 625, a 53.4% reduction, clearing the 25% source requirement. Boundary: Does not claim production counted syntax alone clears the 25% threshold.

Cat 2 Diff

Bundle Size

proven

Before

Total JS/CSS: 2262.65 KB; full web/dist 3351.53 KB. Largest chunk: assets/index-C2vAyoQ1.js at 2025.10 KB. Top dependencies: emoji-picker-react 399.59 KB; highlight.js 377.92 KB; yjs 264.92 KB.

After

Initial entry chunk: 2025.10 KB -> 528.48 KB in latest dist artifact; -73.9%. After artifact: cat2-closeout bundle stats and HTML analysis are present. Claim boundary: Total JS/CSS increased, so the completion claim is code splitting / initial page load, not total bundle reduction.

Reviewer Meaning

Initial entry bundle decreased from 2025.10 KB to 528.48 KB, a 73.9% reduction, clearing the 20% code-splitting target with before/after bundle-analysis output present. Boundary: Does not claim total bundle reduction.

Cat 3 Diff

API Response Time

proven

Before

Audit scale: ship_dev audit-load data; same local database for before and after. Benchmark matrix: 5 endpoints at 10, 25, and 50 concurrent connections. Measurement control: Built server mode with explicit non-production rate-limit bypass.

After

Endpoint 1: GET /api/bootstrap P95 improved by 41.9%, 60.3%, and 45.1% at 10/25/50c. Endpoint 2: GET /api/dashboard/my-week P95 improved by 21.1%, 37.7%, and 36.3% at 10/25/50c. Status: Proven against the source requirement.

Reviewer Meaning

GET /api/bootstrap and GET /api/dashboard/my-week clear the 20% P95 reduction bar at 10, 25, and 50 concurrent connections under identical benchmark conditions. Boundary: Does not claim rate limiting was weakened in production.

Cat 4 Diff

Database Query Efficiency

proven

Before

Main page flow: 41 SQL queries across 10 API calls. Five flows audited: Load main page, view document, list issues, load sprint board, search content. N+1 status: No row-level N+1 confirmed; fanout was the key issue.

After

Protected docs startup: 33 queries across 7 requests -> 24 queries across 1 bootstrap request. Query reduction: -9 queries / -27.3%; request count -85.7%. EXPLAIN proof: Before/after bootstrap constituent EXPLAIN section is present in the latest perf artifact.

Reviewer Meaning

Protected docs startup app-shell query count decreased from 33 to 24 queries, a 27.3% reduction, with before/after bootstrap EXPLAIN evidence now present. Boundary: Does not claim row-level N+1 was fixed.

Cat 5 Diff

Test Coverage and Quality

proven

Before

Total tests: 1471 executable tests across 115 files. Baseline unit pass/fail: API 451/0/0; web 138/13/0. Coverage: API around 40%; web coverage later measured at 37.1% statements.

After

Meaningful regressions: Overlapping comment mark removal; project issue filtering; private document comment visibility. Current unit suites: API 46 files / 554 tests passing; web 22 files / 172 tests passing. Known caveat: Full E2E rerun passed 872/872 with retry artifacts recorded.

Reviewer Meaning

Category 5 clears the improvement target through three meaningful regression tests: overlapping comment mark removal, project issue filtering, and private document comment visibility. Boundary: Does not claim zero retry artifacts under every worker count.

Cat 6 Diff

Runtime Error and Edge Case Handling

proven

Before

Console errors: 0 during normal checked usage after clearing Console. Network disconnect: Partial; Backlinks failed silently/console-only while offline. Malformed input: Mixed; missing CSRF returned HTML stack page.

After

Focused runtime E2E: Focused runtime refresh: 8 passed / 0 failed with named screenshots. Proven fixes: CSRF JSON 403, offline editor draft preservation, and AI unavailable degraded mode are documented. Third fix: AI/Bedrock unavailable path returns controlled JSON and visible degraded UI without clearing editor content.

Reviewer Meaning

Category 6 now has three documented error-handling fixes: CSRF JSON errors, offline editor draft preservation, and AI unavailable degraded mode. Boundary: Does not count comments authorization hardening as a Category 6 user-facing runtime proof.

Cat 7 Diff

Accessibility Compliance

proven

Before

Lighthouse pages: 7 pages audited; lowest scores were /docs and /documents/:id at 91. Critical/serious baseline: 2 critical nodes and 40 serious nodes. Manual coverage: Keyboard partial; screen reader partial.

After

Official selected pages: /docs, selected /documents/:id, and /projects all report 0 critical/serious axe violations. Supporting page: /my-week also reports 0 critical/serious axe violations, but is not the official top-three replacement. Lighthouse: Not rerun in repo-local toolchain; claim is the source-allowed axe critical/serious closeout path.

Explicit Non-Claims

Cat 1: Type Safety

  • Does not claim production counted syntax alone clears the 25% threshold.
  • Does not claim all syntax categories carry equal semantic risk.
  • Does not claim every untyped callback parameter has been eliminated.

Cat 2: Bundle Size

  • Does not claim total bundle reduction.
  • Does not claim every large async chunk is optimized.

Cat 3: API Response Time

  • Does not claim rate limiting was weakened in production.
  • Does not claim every measured endpoint improved.
  • Does not claim the large-fixture current benchmark is before/after proof by itself.
  • Does not claim payload-byte reduction alone is equivalent to P95 latency improvement.

Cat 4: Database Query Efficiency

  • Does not claim row-level N+1 was fixed.
  • Does not claim Cat 3 latency improvement from Cat 4 evidence.

Cat 5: Test Coverage and Quality

  • Does not claim zero retry artifacts under every worker count.
  • Does not claim code coverage percentage improved.
  • Does not count stale selector cleanup as one of the three meaningful regression tests.

Cat 6: Runtime Error and Edge Case Handling

  • Does not count comments authorization hardening as a Category 6 user-facing runtime proof.
  • Does not count migration runner hardening as a Category 6 proof.
  • Does not claim all error-boundary gaps are fixed.

Cat 7: Accessibility Compliance

  • Does not claim Lighthouse 100.
  • Does not claim full manual keyboard/screen-reader certification.

Cat 8: Security Audit

  • Does not claim remote production penetration testing.
  • Does not claim capability-scoped API tokens beyond the verified super-admin route denial check.
  • Does not claim future dependency advisories will remain zero without rerunning pnpm security:probe.
